name: Lake Oconee / Greensboro KOA Holiday
note: KOA Holiday at 2541 Carey Station Road, Greensboro; full-hookup RV sites, pull-throughs. RV sites $26.25-68.95 a night before tax for a mid-May 2027 weeknight on KOA's booking form. RV Life 4*, $$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: KOA booking form (koa.com/campgrounds/lake-oconee/reserve/) quoted 2027-05-18, 1 night, 23-ft motorhome: RV site types $26.25-68.95 before tax (read 2026-10-19); RV Life 4* over 130 reviews, 85 sites
wf: KOA's booking form names 'Lake Front', 'Lake View' and 'Water View' site types, re-audited: satellite (Esri, sat.py) read 2026-10-19: loops under heavy canopy east of a Lake Oconee cove; a beach and docks lie at the cove but the pads are 50+ m back in the trees; not waterfront (canopy, couldn't confirm a view); a site-type name alone cannot upgrade
